import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long sn = 10000000, sd = 1;
        long den = 1;
        while (den <= n) {
            long num = (2 * x * den + y) / (2 * y);
            if (Math.abs(x * sd - sn * y) * den > Math.abs(x * den - num * y) * sd) {
                sn = num;
                sd = den;
            }
            den++;
        }
        System.out.println(sn + "/" + sd);
    }
}
